subject: Notes
body: Thank you for your time and consideration.

I will reach out to you again on Monday to continue our discussion.

I'll create a draft email file for you to review before sending. Could you provide some details about the outage so I can make this more specific:
- What type of outage was there (power, network, service)?
- When did it occur?
- Any impact or resolution status?

In the meantime, here's a basic draft with placeholders:

ACTION: file_write
path: email_draft_outage.txt
content: Subject: Outage Update - [Date/Time]

Hi Tom,

I wanted to inform you about an outage that occurred on [DATE/TIME]. 

Details of what happened:
- Type of issue: [POWER/NETWORK/SERVICE OUTAGE]
- Duration: [START TIME] to [END TIME] 
- Impact: [DESCRIPTION OF IMPACT]
- Status: [RESOLVED/INVESTIGATING/etc.]

We're working on preventing similar issues in the future. Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
END
